mapper.select: SELECT TENANT_ID FROM PEACH_TENANT WHERE ID = #{tenantRefId} AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ID AS id, ORG_ID AS orgId, TENANT_ID AS tenantId, PARENT_ORG_REF_ID AS parentOrgRefId, VERSION AS version, STATUS AS status, IS_DELETE AS isDelete FROM PEACH_ORGANIZATION WHERE ID = #{id} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantBusinessId} AND IS_DELETE = 0

WITH RECURSIVE ORG_DESC (ID, DEPTH) AS ( SELECT ID, 1 FROM PEACH_ORGANIZATION WHERE ID = #{ancestorOrgRefId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantBusinessId} AND STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND IS_DELETE = 0 UNION ALL SELECT CHILD.ID, P.DEPTH + 1 FROM PEACH_ORGANIZATION CHILD INNER JOIN ORG_DESC P ON CHILD.PARENT_ORG_REF_ID = P.ID WHERE CHILD.TENANT_ID = #{tenantBusinessId} AND CHILD.STATUS = 'ENABLE' AND CHILD.IS_DELETE = 0 AND P.DEPTH < (#{maxDepth} + 1) )
SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ORG_DESC WHERE DEPTH > #{maxDepth}) THEN NULL ELSE ID END FROM ORG_DESC LIMIT #{limit}
